integrity: The arithmetic proof is self-contained modulo classical 48-line count and standard facts about smooth quartic K3 surfaces; finite-field computations are corroborative. The stated local Artin structures follow from a Nakayama argument and the explicit modulo-nine obstruction. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The decomposition is for the fixed Fermat quartic over the three-adic integers and its unramified quadratic extension. It concerns the embedded-line Hilbert scheme, not deformation of other polarized K3 surfaces or higher-degree curves; prior literature establishes the 48 and 112 line counts. Complete historical priority is not established.
title: The triadic Fano scheme of lines on the Fermat quartic
